subject: Recurring School Committee Report Schedule
overview: The subcommittee reviewed a draft master list of recurring reports to establish a predictable annual calendar and streamline communication between the administration and the School Committee. Members debated the specific data points required for items ranging from enrollment and financial expenditure rates to special education monitoring and staff professional development.

items.title: Establishment of Periodic Report Schedule
items.summary: Chair Paul Ruseau introduced a motion to create a transparent annual schedule for required and best-practice reports to improve administrative efficiency and assist new committee members.

items.title: Defining Periodic Versus Ad Hoc Reports
items.summary: Members discussed the distinction between recurring periodic reports, which will be automatically scheduled on the calendar, and one-off ad hoc requests that follow a separate policy.

items.title: Review of Draft Report Spreadsheet
items.summary: The subcommittee conducted a line-by-line review of a draft spreadsheet containing dozens of recurring items, including enrollment data, warrant approvals, student handbooks, and budget 'burn' reports.

items.title: Professional Development and Special Education Reporting
items.summary: The committee discussed moving professional development reports to the beginning of the school year and refined reporting requirements for Tiered Focused Monitoring in special education.

items.title: Additional Report Requests and Next Steps
items.summary: Members proposed adding reports for kindergarten enrollment trends, early literacy testing results, and union grievance statistics before adjourning to further refine the document for a future meeting.
